newsitem.title: USA: Argosy Gaming begins exchange offer.
newsitem.headline: Argosy Gaming begins exchange offer.

text.p: Argosy Gaming Co said Thursday it has begun an offer to exchange an old debt issue, which had been a private placement, with a new issue that is expected to trade publicly.
The new issue will carry the same terms as the old issue.

Argosy Gaming will exchange $1,000 in principal amount of its old 13-1/4 percent first mortgage notes due 2004, for each $1,000 in principal amount of its new outstanding 13-1/4 percent first mortgage notes due 2004.
The exchange offer will expire on October 11, 1996, unless extended.
Argosy Gaming develops, owns and operates riverboat casinos and related entertainment facilities in the midwestern and southern United States.
